product.name: Office Space Leasing
product.description: Leasable office space for companies seeking headquarters or other business premises within KAFD, including adaptable floor plans and access to district business infrastructure.

product.name: Residential Leasing
product.description: Furnished, technology-enabled residences in high-rise towers, with multiple apartment layouts, smart-home controls, and optional premium customization.

product.name: Retail Space Leasing
product.description: Leasable retail premises for brands, restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and other customer-facing businesses serving KAFD’s residents, workers, and visitors.

product.name: KAFD Conference Center
product.description: A flexible event venue of more than 28,000 square meters for workshops, gala dinners, team events, conferences, and other business or social gatherings.

identifier.value: Business IT and Data Center Infrastructure

product.name: Business IT and Data Center Infrastructure
product.description: High-speed connectivity and data-center infrastructure supporting the technology and operational requirements of businesses located in KAFD.

product.name: District Mobility and Access Services
product.description: Integrated transport and pedestrian infrastructure connecting KAFD buildings, Riyadh Metro, parking facilities, cycling routes, buses, and an autonomous tram system.
